_doc: PyPI upload limits per Mojolearn project, the values PyPI has actually granted.
file_bytes is the largest single upload (one wheel); project_bytes is the total of every file of every release.
A project not listed takes the defaults. A pending request never raises a limit: change the value only when
PyPI closes the request with a grant, and record the date and issue here.
Read by packaging/pypi_limits.py (the Linux packer, the macOS shrink step, tools/one_layout.py and the release plan).

defaults.source: PyPI defaults: 100 MiB per file, 10 GiB per project
